body:
emily.chen: Heads-up: new POC hit where streaming + function/tool call interleaves extra text and code fences, causing customer JSON parser to fail. Repro attached.
diego_sales: Who's the customer and what endpoint?
emily.chen: Customer: CoreBank. Endpoint: hosted /v1/chat.completions, model redwood-xy-3. They call policy_tool and expect one clean JSON object back. Works if stream=false, fails with stream=true.
jared_runtime: Paste the sanitized stream output?
emily.chen: Sanitized stream below: 
[chunk] {"role":"tool","name":"policy_tool","content":"{\"status\":\"ok\",\"notes\":\"allowed\"}"} 
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"\nHere's a quick summary:\n"} 
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"\n```{\"verdict\":{\"score\":0.01}}```\n"} 
[end stream]

polly_security: Customer saw JSONDecodeError: Extra data — the triple-backticks plus the inserted summary break their simple parser. They also included an encryption/QSA packet asking about TLS versions and KMS options.
diego_sales: Sales questions: can we give a Dedicated eval price for 5x-A100 equiv and can we promise a quick fix ETA?
jared_runtime: Short-term mitigation: 1) ask customer to disable streaming OR 2) prompt-level guard: system note "STRICT_JSON_OUTPUT: output exactly one JSON object, no fences, no commentary" AND SDK-level post-process to strip code fences and only parse the last assistant JSON blob. The regex trick helps but is brittle.
jared_runtime: We have an internal PR to add framing markers around tool/assistant boundaries and a runtime flag strict_json_stream that returns a stream error if any non-json text is emitted. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/5011 (CI in flight).
ops-bot: Canary rollout note: PR 5011 queued, unit tests passing, integration flaky tests being retried.
polly_security: For QSA: we can confirm TLS1.2+ by default, recommend TLS1.3 for Dedicated, and customer-managed KMS available for Private. I'll draft a short QSA template and send.
diego_sales: Pricing: provisional for 5x-A100 equiv ~65k/month list, can offer 30-day eval credit ~20% off pending finance approval.
emily.chen: Action items: emily -> send provisional quote and triage call invite; jared -> post PR link and short mitigation snippet; polly -> send QSA draft; ops -> consider quota bump for eval.
jared_runtime: Minimal mitigation snippet (pseudo):
# assemble assistant-only chunks after tool end
buf = ""
for ev in stream:
  if ev['role'] == 'assistant':
    buf += ev['content']
# naive fence strip
buf = re.sub(r"^```+|```+$", "", buf)
try:
  parsed = json.loads(buf)
except Exception:
  # fallback: abort stream and request non-streaming retry\  raise

diego_sales: I'll include finance & security on the triage invite. emily, please add minimal repro & raw logs so eng can reproduce live.
emily.chen: Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
